Straight answers

Admission questions from students & parents.

Know the policy before you make a payment.

Can I apply before my Class 10 or 12 results?

You can enquire and discuss likely pathways. Provisional or final admission rules depend on the course and document requirements; [CONFIRM: State NGA policy for awaiting results].

Are January and July the only batches?

The planned intake cycle is January Batch / July Batch. [CONFIRM: Add exact commencement dates, application deadlines and whether additional batches operate.]

Can parents attend counselling?

Yes, parents are encouraged to join. It is particularly useful when comparing complete costs, accommodation, medical requirements and post-course realities.

Is admission the same as a job offer?

No. Admission confirms enrolment under stated terms, not employment. Recruitment is a separate process influenced by eligibility, performance, documents and vacancies.

What if I am found medically unfit?

Do not wait until after major payments to investigate medical eligibility. [CONFIRM: Insert NGA’s refund/deferral policy and timing.] Medical decisions belong with the appropriate approved professionals.
